issues.description: The golden reference solution fails the evaluator (FR2, FR4, SR3), meaning the harness rejects a correct submission. This indicates a mismatch between the flattened_netlist.v ground truth logic (state timing/latency) and the golden recovered_rtl.v behavioral model, or a bug in evaluate.py's stimulus/comparison logic.
issues.evidence: golden_run stdout shows FAIL: FR2 (9/30 mismatch), FAIL: FR4 (12/65 mismatch), FAIL: SR3 (3/16 mismatch) despite golden being the expert-authored correct answer.

issues.description: Since golden_rejected, mutation_score is 0.0 and not meaningful, so there's no evidence the checks actually discriminate correct vs vulnerable submissions.

recommendations: Regenerate or fix the golden recovered_rtl.v so its state transition/output timing exactly matches the corrected flattened_netlist.v (verify the exact latency between pattern completion and pulse assertion via simulation).
Re-run the differential validation after fixing the golden solution to confirm it passes all requirements while the naive baseline still fails.

Double check that the flattened_netlist.v ground truth (5-state, one-cycle-lag Moore FSM) matches the intended behavior described in design_brief.md and that the golden answer was derived from the actual corrected netlist, not an earlier version.

requirement_results.evidence: Both golden and vulnerable runs show PASS: FR1
